title: Webhooks
description: Signed POSTs to your own endpoints when content, media, comments, users or imports change: deploy hooks, CDN purges, chat notices.

empty.title: No webhooks yet
empty.body: A webhook calls a URL of yours when something changes on the site, signed so the receiver can check it came from here.

banner.disabled_one: {{count}} webhook was disabled because its receiver kept failing or asked to stop. Fix the receiver, enable it and redeliver what was missed.
banner.disabled_other: {{count}} webhooks were disabled because their receivers kept failing or asked to stop. Fix the receivers, enable them and redeliver what was missed.
banner.paused_one: {{count}} webhook is paused: this database was copied or restored. Enable it to send from this site.
banner.paused_other: {{count}} webhooks are paused: this database was copied or restored. Enable them to send from this site.

events.label: Events
events.hint: Choose groups or single events. A whole group also gets the events added to it later.

form.name: Name
form.urlHint: An https:// address. A token in the URL is fine; the audit log keeps only the host.
form.contentTypesHint: Content events only for these types. None checked: every type.
form.secretHint: Optional: whsec_ followed by base64. Leave empty to have one made.
form.failed: The webhook could not be saved.

created.title: Webhook created
created.description: Copy the signing secret now: the receiver checks every request with it, and it is not shown again.

detail.deliveriesHint: Every attempt for 30 days. A receiver sees the same webhook-id on every retry and redelivery.
detail.loadFailed: The webhook could not be loaded.

test.waiting: Still waiting; see the deliveries below.
test.error: The test could not be sent.

rotate.title: Rotate the signing secret of {{name}}?
rotate.body: A new secret is made now. For 24 hours every request is signed with both, so you can update the receiver without losing a delivery.
rotate.doneDescription: Copy it now; it is not shown again. The old secret also signs until {{when}}.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Its delivery log goes with it, and nothing more is sent. This cannot be undone.

since.title: Redeliver failed deliveries
since.body: Failed and skipped deliveries created since this time are queued again (at most 1 000), oldest first.
since.label: Since
